name: Rubber Hose Reel
description: A 1930s black-and-white cartoon: an original rubber-hose character with noodle limbs, pie-cut eyes and white gloves bouncing on the beat, on a grey painted set, with film flicker, dust, scratches, a gate weave and art-deco title cards. The whole short bounces to the music: the character and even the props squash and stretch on every beat. Title cards in an art-deco frame open each act, the gag builds in three beats with exaggerated takes, and an iris closes on THE END.
style: 1930s black-and-white cartoon; original rubber-hose character with noodle limbs, pie-cut eyes and white gloves; grey painted set; film flicker, dust, scratches, gate weave; art-deco title cards.
